content.text:
SCENARIOS_DIR := scenarios
DEFAULT_SCENARIO := all
SCENARIO ?= $(DEFAULT_SCENARIO)
TAIL ?= 100
UP_ARGS ?= -d
SERVICES ?=

COMPOSE_FILE_all := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/all.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_data_market_backend := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-data_market_backend.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_data_market_web_ui := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-data_market_web_ui.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_hosting_web_ui := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-hosting_web_ui.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_portal_web_ui := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-portal_web_ui.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_data_store_backend := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-data_store_backend.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_data_viewer_backend := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-data_viewer_backend.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_data_viewer_web_ui := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-data_viewer_web_ui.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_events_backend := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-events_backend.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_file_store_deps := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-file_store-deps.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_headless_cms := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-headless_cms.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_headless_cms_proxy := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-headless_cms_proxy.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_identity_provider := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-identity_provider.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_mobilizon := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-mobilizon.yml
COMPOSE_FILE_portal_backend := $(SCENARIOS_DIR)/debug-portal_backend.yml

COMPOSE_FILE := $(or $(COMPOSE_FILE_$(SCENARIO)),$(error Unknown SCENARIO '$(SCENARIO)'. Valid values: all data_market_backend data_market_web_ui hosting_web_ui portal_web_ui data_store_backend data_viewer_backend data_viewer_web_ui events_backend file_store_deps headless_cms headless_cms_proxy identity_provider mobilizon portal_backend))
COMPOSE := docker compose -f $(COMPOSE_FILE)

.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

.PHONY: help up down ps logs config all-up all-down all-ps all-logs data-market-backend-up data-market-backend-down data-market-backend-ps data-market-backend-logs data-market-web-ui-up data-market-web-ui-down data-market-web-ui-ps data-market-web-ui-logs hosting-web-ui-up hosting-web-ui-down hosting-web-ui-ps hosting-web-ui-logs portal-web-ui-up portal-web-ui-down portal-web-ui-ps portal-web-ui-logs data-store-backend-up data-store-backend-down data-store-backend-ps data-store-backend-logs data-viewer-backend-up data-viewer-backend-down data-viewer-backend-ps data-viewer-backend-logs data-viewer-web-ui-up data-viewer-web-ui-down data-viewer-web-ui-ps data-viewer-web-ui-logs events-backend-up events-backend-down events-backend-ps events-backend-logs file-store-deps-up file-store-deps-down file-store-deps-ps file-store-deps-logs headless-cms-up headless-cms-down headless-cms-ps headless-cms-logs headless-cms-proxy-up headless-cms-proxy-down headless-cms-proxy-ps headless-cms-proxy-logs identity-provider-up identity-provider-down identity-provider-ps identity-provider-logs mobilizon-up mobilizon-down mobilizon-ps mobilizon-logs portal-backend-up portal-backend-down portal-backend-ps portal-backend-logs

help:
	@printf "%s\n" \
		"Usage:" \
		"  make <target> [SCENARIO=all|data_market_backend|data_market_web_ui|hosting_web_ui|portal_web_ui|data_store_backend|data_viewer_backend|data_viewer_web_ui|events_backend|file_store_deps|headless_cms|headless_cms_proxy|identity_provider|mobilizon|portal_backend] [SERVICES='svc1 svc2']" \
		"" \
		"Generic targets:" \
		"  make up SCENARIO=all" \
		"  make down SCENARIO=file_store_deps" \
		"  make ps SCENARIO=identity_provider" \
		"  make logs SCENARIO=all SERVICES='file_store identity_provider'" \
		"  make config SCENARIO=all" \
		"" \
		"Convenience targets:" \
		"  make all-up | all-down | all-ps | all-logs" \
		"  make data-market-backend-up | data-market-backend-down | data-market-backend-ps | data-market-backend-logs" \
		"  make data-market-web-ui-up | data-market-web-ui-down | data-market-web-ui-ps | data-market-web-ui-logs" \
		"  make hosting-web-ui-up | hosting-web-ui-down | hosting-web-ui-ps | hosting-web-ui-logs" \
		"  make portal-web-ui-up | portal-web-ui-down | portal-web-ui-ps | portal-web-ui-logs" \
		"  make data-store-backend-up | data-store-backend-down | data-store-backend-ps | data-store-backend-logs" \
		"  make data-viewer-backend-up | data-viewer-backend-down | data-viewer-backend-ps | data-viewer-backend-logs" \
		"  make data-viewer-web-ui-up | data-viewer-web-ui-down | data-viewer-web-ui-ps | data-viewer-web-ui-logs" \
		"  make events-backend-up | events-backend-down | events-backend-ps | events-backend-logs" \
		"  make file-store-deps-up | file-store-deps-down | file-store-deps-ps | file-store-deps-logs" \
		"  make headless-cms-up | headless-cms-down | headless-cms-ps | headless-cms-logs" \
		"  make headless-cms-proxy-up | headless-cms-proxy-down | headless-cms-proxy-ps | headless-cms-proxy-logs" \
		"  make identity-provider-up | identity-provider-down | identity-provider-ps | identity-provider-logs" \
		"  make mobilizon-up | mobilizon-down | mobilizon-ps | mobilizon-logs" \
		"  make portal-backend-up | portal-backend-down | portal-backend-ps | portal-backend-logs"

up:
	$(COMPOSE) up $(UP_ARGS) $(SERVICES)

down:
	$(COMPOSE) down

ps:
	$(COMPOSE) ps $(SERVICES)

logs:
	$(COMPOSE) logs -f --tail=$(TAIL) $(SERVICES)

config:
	$(COMPOSE) config

all-up:
	$(MAKE) up SCENARIO=all

all-down:
	$(MAKE) down SCENARIO=all

---
deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/scenarios/:
all.yml
debug-data_market_backend.yml
debug-data_market_web_ui.yml
debug-data_store_backend.yml
debug-data_viewer_backend.yml
debug-data_viewer_web_ui.yml
debug-events_backend.yml
debug-file_store-deps.yml
debug-headless_cms.yml
debug-headless_cms_proxy.yml
debug-hosting_web_ui.yml
debug-identity_provider.yml
debug-mobilizon.yml
debug-portal_backend.yml
debug-portal_web_ui.yml

deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/services/:
data_market_backend
data_market_web_ui
data_store_backend
data_viewer_backend
data_viewer_web_ui
events_backend
file_store
headless_cms
headless_cms_proxy
hosting_web_ui
identity_provider
keycloak_sidecar_backend
portal_backend
portal_web_ui
zammad_airflow_bridge

observation.command: cat deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/Makefile | head -80; echo ---; ls deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/scenarios/ deployment/runtimes/compose/dev/services/ | head -60
